_about.title: Ally synergy matrix for the 8 mains, patch 7.41, Ancient-Divine
_about.method: OpenDota SQL explorer, public_matches, avg_rank_tier 60-79 (Ancient+Divine). For main H and ally A: games = matches with A on H's own team, wins = H's team won. Overall winrates (wr_H, wr_A) from explorer, same window (_overall.json). expected = inv_logit(logit(wr_H) + logit(wr_A)) (additive log-odds: 'no special interaction'). synergy_pp = 100*(shrunk - expected) with shrunk = (wins + 500*expected)/(games + 500). raw_diff_pp = raw winrate - (wr_H + wr_A - 0.5), unshrunk linear check. Only allies with games >= 300 are ranked. ci95_pp = 1.96*binomial SE of the raw winrate. Positions/roles are NOT in public_matches: 'roles' are OpenDota hero tags, not the role played.
sources: S11 OpenDota SQL explorer, public_matches (docs/SOURCES.md, Research 07)
_about.support_pool: top_supports/bottom_supports/support_cross use a hand-made pool of usual pos 4/5 heroes (ids in the script, general knowledge): roles are not in the data.
_about.reason_marking: Reasons that rely on knowledge not in abilities.json are marked '(general knowledge, verify)'.

top_allies.name: Winter Wyvern
top_allies.reason: Cold Embrace freezes+heals AM and blocks physical damage (save while farming); Winter's Curse makes enemies hit their own ally - free time to Blink in and Mana Void.

top_allies.name: Bane
top_allies.reason: Fiend's Grip steals mana every 0.5 s based on max mana -> emptier pools = bigger Mana Void; Nightmare/Enfeeble shut the enemy offlaner in lane.

top_allies.name: Dazzle
top_allies.reason: Shallow Grave keeps AM alive through ganks while he farms; Weave adds ally armor / removes enemy armor (more Mana Break hits land).

top_allies.name: Omniknight
top_allies.reason: Guardian Angel = physical immunity, Repel = debuff immunity; Purification heals in lane - covers AM's weak 0-20 min.

top_allies.name: Death Prophet
top_allies.reason: Exorcism takes towers fast and Silence locks spellcasters: DP creates map pressure while AM farms (general knowledge, verify).

top_allies.name: Kez
top_allies.reason: Kez is a weak-overall tempo core; AM's late game may cover Kez's falloff (hypothesis, general knowledge, verify; noise?).

top_allies.name: Abaddon
top_allies.reason: Aphotic Shield dispels and absorbs damage, Mist Coil heals: breaks lane harass and disables on AM.

top_allies.name: Warlock
top_allies.reason: Fatal Bonds shares damage between bound enemies -> Mana Void's AoE damage is spread to the whole bonded team; Chaotic Offering stun sets it up.
